description: Check what sourced data Streaming Lens holds on a company, market, country or topic — WITHOUT returning the values. Returns how many datapoints match, which reports they sit in, which countries and years they cover, the confidence mix, when the most recent one was updated, and one sample datapoint with its metric name, unit, country, source and confidence but its value withheld. Use this to tell a user whether the answer to their question exists in the database and what it would take to read it. Matching is word-bounded, so short acronyms do not match inside longer words. Free access — no API key required. Read-only: it never returns the values, and the response says which reports hold them. It also searches the verticaldrama.tv catalog: vertical drama series titles and actor names, returned with their platform, page URL and cast or series (field `catalog`); sources, metrics, rankings and roles for those series are in the paid vertical-invasion-2026 silo.

country.description: Restrict to one country as spelled in the data (e.g. "Nigeria").

query.description: Company, market, country, platform, topic, vertical drama series title or actor name (e.g. "ReelShort", "mobile money", "Nigeria", "micro-drama", "The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband").

name: check_data_coverage

outputSchema.description: Tool-specific result object. Inspect the `content` array for human-readable text and structured data.
